raw_text: The EU DisinfoLab Indian Chronicles report is absolutely damning. 750+ fake media outlets operating across 116 countries for 15 years. They resurrected the names of dead newspapers, created fake NGOs to lobby at the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva, and even had fake journalists attending EU Parliament events. The scale of this operation is unprecedented in documented influence operations. What's particularly interesting is how the network was used to amplify anti-Pakistan narratives at international forums. The Srivastava Group connection has been documented since the first EU DisinfoLab report in 2019 but the updated findings show the network actually expanded after being exposed.
